title: Carlene W NDE 773
content:
In 1990, I was found in a coma and I died for a bit. During this time, I saw a black hole with a circle of light that I was traveling through. A sense of peacefulness, which is indescribable, came over me. I continued to go through the tunnel/circle of light. I wanted to stay because the feeling, the peacefulness, was so complete. Somehow, I knew it was heaven; I looked to see if my grandmother and my daughter Becky was there. They were - and again I felt a peace knowing that they were all right. I also saw another friend, who supposedly committed suicide. I could hear my family and my other daughters talking to me. I needed to come back and help them. I wanted to hold on to that peace that I felt; however, my family needed me. I soon came out of the coma. Later I found out, the doctors tried everything but it wasn't till my daughters were allowed in my room that I came out of the coma.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness mosquito...encephalitis of the brain Clinical death I don't think I was declared dead, they worked to get my system stabilized. However, there is a short time they thought they lost me.Encephalitis, did die for a while.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review
elements.At what time during the experience were: Pretty high. Time was different, it seemed like a long time but it wasn't.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time seemed to go slower than normal.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Not that I can recall - but I saw my parents, children crying, and around me.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Tunnel of light with some darkness in the middle.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes An angel I think. Asked about my daughter, grandmother and saw them. Then I saw a friend. They were okay, didn't have to worry about them.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Indescribable.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I am not afraid of dying; I know my loved ones are okay.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Some things, I never take my daughters that I have for granted. Quit mourning my oldest daughter, and do my best for my daughters, that survived.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Peaceful, but confused - wanted to stay and experience the peacefulness yet I wanted to be with my boyfriend and family. They needed me to stay, how could I ask my mother to go through that pain of loss; I am the only daughter. I also remembered how I felt when I had to bury my daughter, there is no loss like that and it is hard to bounce back from.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I did believe in God, but now I know there is a heaven. When someone dies, I know they can see me and be with me for they are only in a different dimension.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best is that I no longer mourned for my daughter, I knew she was in heaven with my grandmother. I wanted to live and to do that I had to give up that sense of peace.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some people close to me. I hope I influenced them
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Wish I could get hypnotized to bring back more of what I felt when this happened.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: This is a rather thorough questionnaire - impressed.
